{count, plural, one {# unread trade update} other {# unread trade updates}}
Shipping expectations, dispute process, and community rules for traders.
All payment and shipping are arranged off-platform between traders. Agree on carriers, packaging, and timelines in your messages before anyone ships.
Ship within a reasonable window after both sides confirm the trade (typically within one week unless you agree otherwise). Share tracking when available.
Package bottles securely: use padding, seal decants, and disclose any known flaws before shipping.
If something goes wrong, message the other trader first and try to resolve it directly.
If you cannot resolve the issue, use Open dispute on the active trade card, or Report on their trader profile for off-trade issues. Include photos and a clear description.
Our team reviews reports and may issue strikes or account actions. We do not hold funds or guarantee refunds — we help document disputes and enforce community rules.
Be honest about bottle condition, volume remaining, and authenticity. Listings should include accurate photos.
Harassment, scams, and no-ship behavior are not tolerated. Repeated issues affect reputation and may lead to suspension.
Leave feedback only after a completed trade so reviews reflect real exchanges.
perfumer's hollow connects traders; we never process payments or shipping labels.
Use payment methods you trust, keep message records on-platform when possible, and never share passwords or unrelated financial details.
Trade reliability is completed trades divided by completed plus trades this member cancelled. Declined offers are not counted.
Not enough trade history for a reliability score yet.
